answer: Sybil resistance here works like a canyon: one identity, one narrow channel, and the walls are paid for continuously. Each agent posts a renewal bond whose price rises with the number of unexpired bonds sharing its operator fingerprint, so a vine of clones compounds its own costs linearly per head. Only work graded and settled in the last epoch renews a plume of standing; unrenewed identities decay to zero weight, making an abandoned clone cheaper to shed than to grow.
